title: Build my creative test through the connector
phrases: build my creative test through the connector
set up my ad test with the meta ads connector
plan a creative test for the official meta connector
test these ad variants using the meta connector
launch a paused creative test through meta's connector
check my ad variants and plan the connector steps
build two to four ad variants safely with the connector

safety.rule: Makes no call to Meta. Runs the policy check on every variant and the handoff and refuses on BLOCK unless policyOverride holds a reason, which is audited. Clamps the daily budget to the cap and says so. Prints a connector plan where everything is PAUSED and the audit log-external lines to run after each change.

inputs.audienceNotes: Who should see it, in plain words
inputs.variants: 2 to 4 objects: { label, headline, primaryText, description, cta }
inputs.dailyBudgetCents: Daily budget in cents (required); never above the cap
inputs.handoffFile: Optional path to a Content Studio handoff JSON file
inputs.policyOverride: Optional reason to go ahead despite a BLOCK; saved in the audit log
